rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the third scoring phase

categories.label: Castle points + king bonus for each scoring phase
categories.labelVi: Điểm lâu đài + thưởng vua mỗi giai đoạn
categories.hint: Per castle with your knight: highest knight level x castle surface area (once per castle). King bonus: 5/10/15 for a knight on level 1/2/3 of the king's castle in phase 1/2/3.

categories.label: Points bought with action points during play
categories.labelVi: Điểm mua bằng action point trong lúc chơi
categories.hint: Points spent from the action points; enter total gained outside scoring phases.

tiebreakers.description: No two score markers may share a space; a player who would tie moves forward one point (rule seen in the digital adaptation and BoardGameGeek summaries).

notes: family: running-track. Three scoring phases: after phase 1 (4 rounds) and phases 2-3 (3 rounds each). Several players may score the same castle. After each scoring the lowest-scoring player may move the king. Official rulebook PDF could not be downloaded; verified via Yucata rule summary, GameRules.com and Wikipedia, so medium confidence.
